 Downtown Terre Haute Farmers Market moves indoors to Ohio Building 
 Downtown Terre Haute Farmers Market moves indoors to Ohio Building (Audrey Geib) By Audrey Geib Published : Nov. 7, 2026 at 6:47 PM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google TERRE HAUTE, Ind. (WTHI) - The Downtown Terre Haute Farmers Market is moving indoors for the winter at the Ohio Building, bringing shoppers to a space with a long history of gathering over food.
 Address: 672 Ohio St, Terre Haute, IN 47807
 Jordan Shire, president of the market’s board, said the building’s owners reached out about partnering with the market.
 “The owners of the Ohio building reached out and they said, hey, we’d really love to partner with you,” Shire said.
 Visitors can also enjoy brunch at The Lobby at the Ohio Building from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. before or after exploring the market.
 Upcoming market dates
 After opening day, the indoor market is scheduled for:
 Nov. 21 
 Dec. 5 
 Dec. 19 
 Feb. 6 
 March 6 
 April 3 
 Shire said the market plans to return to the courthouse the following summer.
 SNAP benefits and parking
 The market accepts SNAP and offers a ‘Double Up’ program. Shire said that for the first $20 customers cash out, the market provides an additional $20 to spend on produce.
 Parking is available in the First Financial lot and on the street.
